=== a register window
	.text
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	save %sp, -176, %sp
	.cfi_def_cfa_register %fp
	.cfi_window_save
	.cfi_register %o7, %i7
	.cfi_offset %l0, -8
	.cfi_offset %g1, -12
	.cfi_offset %f2, -16
	.cfi_same_value %o0
	ret
	restore
	.cfi_endproc
=== a leaf function with lines
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	.cfi_startproc
	retl
	.loc 1 4 5 prologue_end
	mov 0, %o0
	.cfi_endproc
=== a sequence address aligned in its fragment but not in the section
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.file 2 "b.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 1
	nop
	.section .text.b,"ax",%progbits
	.loc 2 2 200
	nop
	nop
	.data
	.loc 1 3
	.long 1
=== sequences in 64-bit fragments
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.file 2 "b.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 1
	nop
	.section .text.b,"ax",%progbits
	.loc 2 2 5
	nop
	.section .text.c,"ax",%progbits
	.loc 1 2 200
	nop
	.section .text.d,"ax",%progbits
	.loc 1 2 200 discriminator 3
	nop
